verdict.rationale: Portkey says it has open-sourced its AI gateway and that it runs locally with a single command (`npx @portkey-ai/gateway`), so the routing and inference core can be self-hosted. The rest of the platform, including logs, model catalog, budgets and guardrails, is documented only against the hosted `api.portkey.ai`, with no evidence that it can be self-hosted. missing for 10: self-hosting of the observability/logs and governance control plane, production deployment docs (Docker/Kubernetes, enterprise on-prem), independent or hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted setup.
